title:
feat(home): y to copy link on dashboard

Adds a CopyLink binding ("y") to the home/dashboard. Copies the web
URL of the selected row to the clipboard and surfaces an OK / Err
toast, matching the existing PR TUI behaviour.

URL extraction is factored out into selectedItemURL() so the Open (o)
and CopyLink (y) handlers share the same per-tab lookup — works for
PRs to review, your PRs, recently closed, recently viewed repos, and
the favourites and browse panes.
